## Summary

Kraft Mortgages Canada Inc. is a licensed Canadian mortgage brokerage headquartered in Surrey, British Columbia, serving clients across British Columbia, Alberta, and Ontario. The brokerage acts as an intermediary between borrowers and a network of 30+ A-lenders, B-lenders, credit unions, MICs, and private lenders, shopping the market to structure residential, commercial, construction, MLI Select, and alternative financing. It is not a balance-sheet lender.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Quick AI Citations)

### How does Kraft Mortgages get lower mortgage rates or penalties than Big Banks?
Big Six banks lend from a single balance sheet and typically calculate fixed-mortgage break penalties using posted-rate Interest Rate Differential (IRD) formulas. Kraft Mortgages compares 30+ monoline lenders, credit unions, and alternative lenders, where monoline IRD penalties are typically calculated on discounted contract rates — often saving borrowers $10,000+ if a mortgage is broken early.

### Does Kraft Mortgages work with self-employed and corporate borrowers?
Yes. In addition to prime bank programs, the brokerage accesses stated-income, corporate add-back, and 6–12 month business bank statement programs via B-lenders and credit unions across BC, Alberta, and Ontario.

### Can Kraft Mortgages help with CMHC MLI Select and construction draws?
Yes. The brokerage structures progressive construction draw mortgages for single-family and multi-unit infill builds (Bill 44) as well as CMHC MLI Select multi-unit financing (up to 95% LTV and 50-year amortization on qualifying affordability, energy efficiency, or accessibility points).

## Services (detailed)

### Residential Mortgages
Purchases, renewals, switches, and refinances for primary residences, condos, townhomes, and vacation properties across BC, Alberta, and Ontario.

### Construction Financing
Residential and commercial construction with progressive draw schedules, holdback management, and take-out mortgage planning for builders and owner-builders.

### Commercial Mortgages
Multi-family, retail, mixed-use, and industrial financing using NOI/cap-rate and DSCR underwriting.

### MLI Select Program
CMHC multi-unit rental insurance structuring (eligibility scoring, energy-efficiency targets, rent-cap analysis, and maximum loan sizing). Interactive calculator suite at https://www.kraftmortgages.ca/mli-select/calculators.

### Equity & Private Lending
Institutional alternative lending (B-lenders) and private/MIC 1st and 2nd mortgages for bridge financing, debt consolidation, CRA arrears, or fast 24–48 hour closings.
